summary: Quality Industrial Corp. disclosed a September 23, 2026 Share Exchange Agreement with majority holder Fusion Fuel Green PLC and three third-party investors. Fusion Fuel will issue 500,000 Class A ordinary shares, valued at $2.0 million at $4.00 per share, split 40%/40%/20% to Safir, Ahammed and Almheiri. QIC will issue $2.0 million of common stock to Fusion Fuel, priced at the lower of the prior close or five-day average. Closing conditions include Nasdaq listing approval and Irish Takeover Panel clearance. Watch regulatory approvals and potential dilution/overhang.
